"If wireless Android Auto stops connecting or becomes unstable, follow this sequence in order:
1. On the phone, leave the Android Auto beta program (if you're enrolled). 2. On the phone, clear the Android Auto app's data. 3. In the phone's Bluetooth settings, forget the head unit. 4. In the head unit's Bluetooth settings, forget the phone. 5. In Config, tap Check for update (it checks the ConnAdaptor too). 6. When it finishes, go back to the home screen and tap Activate here. 7. Start pairing from the head unit's Bluetooth and accept the connection on the phone. 8. Restart the head unit by holding Back + Music on the steering wheel for 15 seconds. 9. Tap Activate again.
Note: if after starting the car and tapping Android Auto on screen it doesn't connect within about a minute, tap Restart."
